name: Memories With You
storyline:
The main character, whose life suddenly ended up on the edge because of a terrible diagnosis, spends his last days in a bar, trying to drown the pain with alcohol and memories. His youth was full of missed opportunities, unfulfilled feelings, and shattered hopes. But everything changes when a mysterious girl in a seductive circus outfit sits next to him. She calls herself Arlequina — a charismatic and enigmatic figure who offers the hero a chance to make things right and change his life.

With Arlequina’s magical cards, he’s granted the ability to travel back into his past and reconnect with three women whose hearts he once failed to win. Each is utterly unique: from a fiery schoolteacher to a bold fitness enthusiast. But this journey won’t be easy. To change his fate, he will have to play thrilling card games, uncover their personalities, and defeat them in battles of wits. And victory will bring not only passionate moments but also new perspectives for his future.
summary: Memories with You is a fun visual novel, the final one of "to You" game series. Reunite once again with familiar characters Arlequina and Alicia in their new roles, experience a series of humorous stories, and help the protagonist, Mitch, find love among three captivating girls!
